## Analysis Overview

This notebook contains the workflow used to evaluate the three-species LFQ benchmark dataset presented in the QC Espresso manuscript. The analysis uses DIA-NN protein-group quantifications from mixtures of human HEK293, *Saccharomyces cerevisiae*, and *Escherichia coli* K-12 protein lysates prepared at defined proportions and measured in technical triplicates. Metrics describing quantitative accuracy, fold-change recovery, and reproducibility are calculated and visualized to provide a reference example of the expected behavior of a well-performing proteomics experiment.


## Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

## Import DIA-NN Protein Matrix

```{r import}
report <- read.delim("report.pg_matrix.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

## Data Preparation

Contaminant protein groups were removed and protein groups assigned to their corresponding species.

```{r preparation}
df <- report %>%
  filter(!grepl("crap", Protein.Group, ignore.case = TRUE))

df <- df %>%
  filter(!(
      grepl("_HUMAN", Protein.Names) +
      grepl("_YEAST", Protein.Names) +
      grepl("_ECOLI", Protein.Names) > 1))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(species = case_when(
      grepl("_HUMAN", Protein.Names) ~ "HUMAN",
      grepl("_YEAST", Protein.Names) ~ "YEAST",
      grepl("_ECOLI", Protein.Names) ~ "ECOLI",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species))
```

## Benchmark Design

```{r benchmark-design}
sample_composition <- tibble(
  species = c("HUMAN", "YEAST", "ECOLI"),
  A = c(65, 15, 20),
  B = c(65, 30, 5)) %>%
  mutate(expected_logFC = log2(B / A))

sample_composition
```

## Sample Groups

```{r sample-groups}
A_cols <- c(
  "20240509_LFQ_A_1",
  "20240509_LFQ_A_2",
  "20240509_LFQ_A_3")

B_cols <- c(
  "20240509_LFQ_B_1",
  "20240509_LFQ_B_2",
  "20240509_LFQ_B_3")
```

## Protein Filtering

Only proteins quantified in all replicates were retained.

```{r filtering}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    nA = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(A_cols)))),
    nB = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(B_cols))))) %>%
  filter(nA == 3, nB == 3)
```

## Quantitative Metrics

```{r metrics}
metrics <- df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_A = mean(c_across(all_of(A_cols))),
    mean_B = mean(c_across(all_of(B_cols))),
    sd_A = sd(c_across(all_of(A_cols))),
    sd_B = sd(c_across(all_of(B_cols))),
    cv_A = 100 * sd_A / mean_A,
    cv_B = 100 * sd_B / mean_B,
    mean_CV = mean(c(cv_A, cv_B), na.rm = TRUE),
    abundance = log2((mean_A + mean_B) / 2),
    observed_logFC = log2(mean_B / mean_A)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Log2 Fold-Change Accuracy

```{r deviation}
df_metrics <- metrics %>%
  left_join(sample_composition %>%
      select(species, expected_logFC), by = "species") %>%
  mutate(deviation = observed_logFC - expected_logFC) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(sd_deviation = sd(deviation, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Summary Metrics

```{r summary-metrics}
accuracy_metrics <- df_metrics %>%
  filter(is.finite(deviation)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    proteins = n(),
    sd_ratio = sd(deviation),
    median_abs_deviation = median(abs(deviation)),
    .groups = "drop")

cv_metrics <- df_metrics %>%
  filter(is.finite(mean_CV)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(proteins = n(),
    median_CV = median(mean_CV),
    mean_CV = mean(mean_CV),
    .groups = "drop")

accuracy_metrics
cv_metrics
```

## Interquartile Range of Observed Fold Changes

```{r iqr}
iqr_df <- df_metrics %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(ymin = quantile(observed_logFC, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax = quantile(observed_logFC, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    expected_logFC = first(expected_logFC),
    .groups = "drop")
```

## Visualization

```{r colors}
cols <- c(
  HUMAN = "#2457A6",
  YEAST = "#4FC3D9",
  ECOLI = "#F28E2B")
```

```{r Box plot}
ggplot(df_metrics,
  aes(species, observed_logFC, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = NULL,  y = expression(log[2]~Fold~Change))
```

```{r fig-foldchange}
ggplot(df_metrics,
  aes(abundance, observed_logFC, colour = species)) +
  geom_rect(data = iqr_df,
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      fill = species),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(data = sample_composition,
    aes(yintercept = expected_logFC, colour = species),
    linetype = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[2]~Average~Abundance),
    y = expression(log[2]~Fold~Change~(B/A)))
```
